title: High Rustler and Oak Creek Annie Cottage Seaside, FL
h1: High Rustler and Oak Creek Annie
meta_description: Check out our new to collection, Oak Creek Annie's and High Rustler, a versatile two-bedroom Seaside, FL home that sleeps 8 with great outdoor spaces and a prime location close to the beach and pools.
description_expanded: Description147 GRAYTON STREETQUEEN, QUEEN, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA, DOUBLE IN LOFT (sleeps 8)A Unique Seaside Retreat with Flexible Living SpacesWelcome to Oak Creek Annie and High Rustler, a charming and versatile vacation rental in Seaside, Florida that comfortably sleeps up to eight guests. Thoughtfully designed with two distinct living spaces, this retreat is ideal for families, couples traveling together, or guests seeking a bit of extra privacy. Perfectly positioned on Natchez Street, the home sits just steps from Seaside’s private beach access and directly across from the West End community pool, offering one of the most desirable locations on 30A.First-Floor Queen Suite | Comfort & PrivacyThe first floor features a beautifully appointed queen bedroom suite, designed as a peaceful haven after days spent at the beach. This space includes custom built-in storage, a charming bay window, a private flat-screen TV, and an en-suite bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination—ideal for both comfort and convenience.Second-Floor Living Space & Sleeping LoftThe second level opens into a bright and airy open-concept living area with soaring ceilings and an inviting coastal feel. Anchored by a spacious living room with a large flat-screen TV, this level is designed for gathering and relaxing. A queen sleeper sofa in the living area provides additional sleeping accommodations, while a bonus sleeping loft—accessible via a ship’s ladder—offers a full bed and flat-screen TV, making it a favorite retreat for kids or teens.The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and marble countertops, perfectly equipped for preparing family meals or beach-day snacks. Just off the kitchen, a full bathroom with a single vanity and large walk-in shower adds ease for guests. Step outside onto the open-air balcony, where a bistro table for two creates the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening breezes.Private Studio Suite with Gulf & Town ViewsA final private space awaits via an exterior staircase off the front porch. This stylish upper-level studio offers its own private entry, a comfortable queen bed, and a full en-suite bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. From the entry area and charming Juliette balcony, guests can enjoy peaceful views of the Gulf and the surrounding Seaside townscape, adding a special sense of escape and serenity.Ideal Location for the Ultimate Seaside GetawayWith its flexible layout, prime location near the beach and pool, and multiple private living areas, Oak Creek Annie and High Rustler offers a rare combination of convenience, charm, and comfort. Whether you’re traveling with family, friends, or multiple couples, this Seaside vacation rental delivers an unforgettable 30A experience in the heart of it all.* 3-night minimum Fall and Spring. 2 Night Min. Winter. Not available for rent during peak seasons of Spring Break and Summer. (only main home Natchez Compound 6BD is available) . Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESJust 377 feet to Seaside beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Natchez Pavilion, home to the largest private residential beach on 30AFull access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote upon arrival featuring two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided for added convenienceTwo parking passes provided. A golf cart is considered a vehicle; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and documented medical needs may request a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
